keys.label: PLAY
keys.tip: Play the sequence on its own clock (no key needed); again: stop

keys.label: PATTERN
keys.tip: PATTERN: the arp and the sequence play. MIDI: only the notes from your DAW play (a dragged clip switches here by itself)

keys.label: CLIP
keys.tip: Drag onto a DAW track: the sequence as a MIDI clip. Click: save it to Music/JING FANG/MIDI

keys.label: CLEAR
keys.tip: Every step back to its default (right-click a step key: that step off)

keys.label: PATTERN
keys.tip: PATTERN: the beat plays. MIDI: only your DAW's notes 36..43 hit tracks 1..8 (a dragged clip switches here by itself)

keys.label: CLIP
keys.tip: Drag onto a DAW track: the beat as a MIDI clip (tracks 1..8 = notes 36..43). Click: save it to Music/JING FANG/MIDI

keys.label: PLAY
keys.tip: Play the beat on its own clock (no key needed); again: stop

keys.label: CLEAR
keys.tip: Every step of every track off (right-click a step key: that step off)
